QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Traces of Arkarium
QuestInfo.0: #p2144008# came to the Leafre of the Past. Update him on the situation.
QuestInfo.2: You broke #p2144008# free from #p2144010#'s control. Go after #p2144010# before it's too late.

1.0: Ugh... What happened?\r\n#L0##bThat's what I want to know! Why'd you attack me?!#l\n#k
1.1: What? I...attacked you? That can't be...! I'd never betray you, or any of the other agents! This must be #p2144010#'s doing... He was controlling me!\r\n#L0##bI'm just glad you're okay. So, now what do we do?#l\n#k
1.2: I should head back and make sure #p2144010# isn't controlling any of the other agents. #h0#, I leave #p2144010# to you.
